claims: Continue invasive mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings and titrate FiO2/PEEP to maintain adequate oxygenation, reassessing ABG after the recent arterial pO2 84 mmHg on FiO2 80% and PEEP 10-12 cmH2O.
Maintain and titrate vasopressor support (norepinephrine infusion) with frequent hemodynamic monitoring given recent hypotension (NIBP 81/37, mean 49).
Obtain repeat complete blood count with differential and coagulation studies to track the falling platelet count (107 to 49 K/uL) and leukocytosis with circulating blasts.
Assess and manage cytopenias and risk of bleeding, including transfusion thresholds for hemoglobin 9.3 g/dL and platelets 49 K/uL, and monitor for bleeding.
Continue disease-directed therapy for the underlying hematologic malignancy (hydroxyurea, fludarabine/cytarabine-based regimen, tamoxifen) per oncology plan with tumor lysis monitoring.
Monitor for tumor lysis syndrome with serial electrolytes, uric acid, phosphate, calcium, creatinine, and LDH, and maintain adequate hydration/urine output.
Continue antimicrobial therapy (cefepime, vancomycin, voriconazole, acyclovir, TMP-SMX) and reassess for infection given neutropenia and critical illness.
Correct electrolyte abnormalities, including hypokalemia (3.4 mEq/L), hypocalcemia (total 7.9 mg/dL, ionized 1.09 mmol/L), and hyponatremia (129 mEq/L), with repeat labs.
Maintain sedation/analgesia per protocol (propofol and fentanyl infusions, PCA hydromorphone) with daily sedation interruption assessment and delirium monitoring.
Provide supportive ICU care including VTE prophylaxis consideration, glycemic control for glucose 251 mg/dL, and nutrition via existing feeding tube.
